states.description: Undo functionality reverts the last candle placement and restores the consumed light energy

states.name: after_check_10

states.name: after_check_11
states.description: Light energy budget is conserved: the sum of all active candle costs plus remaining budget equals the initial total

states.name: after_check_12
states.description: Attempting to ignite a candle when remaining energy budget is insufficient is prevented and candle stays unlit
